mapper.insert: insert into member (member_id, member_pwd, role, enabled,member_name,member_email,member_phone, member_birth,member_gender,member_join_date,member_nickname) values (#{member_id}, #{member_pwd}, #{role},1,#{member_name},#{member_email},#{member_phone}, #{member_birth},#{member_gender},NOW(),#{member_nickname});
mapper.select: select count(*) from member where member_id =#{member_id}
